messages:
Maya: Heads-up Carla's birthday is next Wednesday (4/8). Quick Q: do we want a 15-min surprise at 3pm in the lounge?

Dmitri: yes please. short & sweet. Ill bring a small speaker for the birthday tune.

Lina G.: 3pm works for me. I can coordinate cake/gift and collect a few bucks from remote folks.

Carla M.: oh no youre planning without me again (jk). Im not online that afternoon but will pop in at the end of day if youre around :) please no peanuts in anything.

Eli: Ill bring balloons + confetti poppers (confetti only if carpet-free zone?).

Maya: Confetti might be rough for SRE desks. maybe streamers instead.

Lina G.: good call. @people-ops-bot can you run a 3-option poll on snacks (cake / mini cupcakes / savory finger food) and schedule a reminder to collect money for e-gift on Tues 11am?

people-ops-bot: Poll "Snack pick for Carla" posted. Options: Cake / Mini cupcakes / Savory finger food. Voting open 48h. Reminder to collect e-gift contributions set for Apr 7 11:00.

Dmitri: voted cupcakes.

Eli: savory.

Maya: cake (GF option pls).

Lina G.: contribution link: https://payments.example/carla-bday please add your name in the notes. collecting until Apr 7 EOD.

Dmitri: chipped in. note: "from infra crew"

Eli: sent $10. message: "happy bday Carla!"

Maya: sent $15. left a note to add GF label.

Lina G.: Thanks! Il pick up cupcakes (will label allergens and bring a GF tray). Meeting surprise: lets assemble at 2:55pm in the lounge, pop in at 3:00. Ill DM the guest list for the brief planning huddle.

Carla M.: youre the best thank you all :)

people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Assemble for Carla surprise" Apr 8 2:55pm.
